name: B10-0351/2026 (ECR) – The abduction, forced conversion and child marriage of Maria Shahbaz and the protection of girls in Pakistan
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the abduction, forced conversion and child marriage of Maria Shahbaz and the protection of girls in Pakistan
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and asking Pakistan to act in the case of Maria Shahbaz, a 13-year-old Christian girl who disappeared in 2025 and was later given into the custody of the man she allegedly married. The Parliament asks Pakistan to protect her, investigate her case openly, and prosecute people who abduct, forcibly convert and marry underage girls from religious minorities.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. The Parliament only asks Pakistan to act.
- **Who it affects:** Maria Shahbaz, and girls from Christian and Hindu minorities in Pakistan.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to Pakistan's government and parliament.
